definitions.gloss: bulleted list; itemized list; listing by items
definitions.explanation: A way of writing that presents information as a series of separate points or items, each on its own line. Common in business documents, presentations, and instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To list the key points in bullet form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the report in bulleted form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り{直|なお}した→作り直す：20924_tsukurinaosu⟧。
examples.english: A bulleted list is easier to read than a long paragraph, so I redid the materials.

notes:
{箇条書|かじょうが}き refers to the format of writing information as a list of separate items or bullet points, rather than in paragraph form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put into list form
- {箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in list form
- {箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to organize into bullet points
- {箇条書|かじょうが}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to present in list form

FORMS:
⟦{箇条|かじょう}→箇条：13832_kajou⟧ (item, article) + {書|が}き (writing)

USAGE:
Very common in business documents, presentations, meeting minutes, and instructions. Often contrasted with ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧ (prose/paragraph form).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{箇条|かじょう}→箇条：13832_kajou⟧: article, item
- ⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧: item, heading
- ⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list, overview
